headline: Seven Fronts Exchange Bases as Fighting Intensifies
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the strategic map shows a sharper tempo of base turnover. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theatre, adding roughly 13,700 Colonial and 16,600 Warden casualties in the past day while its 24‑hour flip count has risen to thirty‑nine from twenty‑nine. Fishermans Row continues to churn, recording thirty‑nine flips centred on Eidolo, Black Well, Arcadia and Fort Ember, a modest increase over the prior thirty‑six. Stlican Shelf has surged further, now logging thirty‑four flips across Vulpine Watch, The Pale House, Thornhold and The Old Mourn. Mooring County and Linn Mercy have both spiked, each posting a half‑dozen new flips in the last two hours with fresh events logged at filing time. Farranac Coast and Stonecradle have renewed activity, the former with eleven flips in the day and the latter ten, while Marban Hollow, Godcrofts and Callahans Passage show only low‑level turnover. Enlistment rates are accelerating in the most contested zones, signalling fresh manpower feeding the ongoing exchanges.
